verification.method: Official NTRS PDF text retrieved by automated fetch; Table 3-31 values read from the extracted text (oxygen 0.895, food solids 0.800 kg/CM-d). The extraction placed the table on report page 59; the table of contents lists page 58.
Official NASA PDF text retrieved by automated fetch; about 70 W and both 33-day VEG-01 date ranges read from the extracted text.
Official CCMC archive table retrieved by automated fetch; the GOES-13 row for 2017-09-10 transcribed by hand into this file. The linked raw JSON was not downloaded or parsed.
Official NASA page retrieved by automated fetch; 384,400 km read from the Size and Distance section.

Seven further GOES-13 rows (2012-03-07, 2012-05-17, 2012-07-12, 2013-04-11, 2014-01-06, 2014-01-07, 2017-07-14) were read from the official CCMC archive table by an automated fetch and entered by an AI assistant. Checks made: the same fetch returned the 2017-09-10 row identical to the hand-transcribed record, and for five of the seven rows the duration derived from the timestamps equals the table's own duration column (the other two differ by under 0.3 hours). Not yet re-read by a team member.
